column1: # ci/rules.tsv - which CI areas a changed path needs. Read by tools/ci_select.py only (make test-changed, test-list, ci;
# Forgejo runs the same `make ci`). Design: PLAN-103 section 9, ticket #123; semantics ported from the maintainer's other repo's path rules.
#   glob:  fnmatch on the repo-relative path, `*` also matches `/`. The FIRST matching rule wins: order matters.
#   areas: comma-separated names from ci/areas.tsv, the alias ALL (= every area), or `-` (baseline only).
# Baseline: `security` always runs. `docs` is added by the `*.md` rule below.
# The last rule is `* ALL`: an unmatched path runs everything (reason=unmatched). Every tracked file must match a
# rule BEFORE it (tools/tests/test_select.py), so a new top-level folder forces a decision here.
# A selector error (bad rules file, unknown base ref) also runs everything: it never silently skips.

column3: # the rules and the selector: its own tests (tools/tests/test_select.py) cover them
# the tools behind make and their tests
# #278 generated pin list: tests/test_versions.py (an always test) checks it
# the entry point of every area
# shared make rules every area includes
# FUNDING.yml (GitHub Sponsor button): docs/tests/test_customer_docs.py reads it
# hktest: every plain-python test imports it
# repo-wide gates: the always list runs them with any code change
# docs: the doc tests; baseline security
# the launcher table: role cores and the image build read it (#244)
# any other skill: not mapped to one area
# ES-DE theme files: theme xml and contrast tests
# the maintainer's curated lists (#190): read by the collections tools and the esde_collections role
# the cabinet config backup (#286): build/tests/test_backup_config.py scans every committed file
# the maintainer's private theme overlay (absent in the community edition)
# configuration core (#118): read by every area until it has its own rules
# changes which files every check lists
